PREVIEW NOTES

Before this goes live

This is an independent design prototype. Prices, package inclusions and service policies need final approval.

  • Existing Breeze logo, Metropolis typeface and #262262 brand colour retained.
  • Contact fields are preview-only: no transmission or page storage. Checkout and booking are not connected.
  • FAQ questions reflect competitor research. Answers are original drafts, not approved Breeze commitments.
  • Pixel illustrations are new, editable SVG artwork.
